name: Rutherford County Schools
seoDescription: Rutherford County Schools calendar dates, two-hour student days, breaks, staff days, conferences, official translations, PDFs, and ICS downloads.
districtFact: RCS academic calendars distinguish two-hour student attendance days from staff-only in-service, administrative, safety, and teacher-work days. The school-year page preserves those labels so families can tell when students attend, when they are out, and when a shortened day still counts as a school day.
calendarNotes: Use the annual RCS Academic Calendar for districtwide attendance dates and the RCS calendar page for revised or translated editions. Parent/teacher conference dates are not automatically no-school days unless the annual calendar says students are out. School events, dismissal details, and later changes should be confirmed with RCS or the student's school. A MySchoolDates ICS file is a one-time import and does not update automatically.
